competences.description: Attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 3 times. The first and second hits steal 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, and the last hit blocks enemies without a beneficial effect from receiving beneficial effects for 2 turns. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Decrease Attack Power.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss is granted with a beneficial effect. When attacking enemies granted with Decrease Attack Power, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
